column2: a falling meteor seen from the side: a round rock head at the bottom centre with a white-hot glow, and a wide flame tail streaming straight UP from it, tapering into wisps near the top. The meteor is vertical, head down, tail up.
one single stylized flame tongue, a teardrop-shaped fire petal pointing straight up, with a brighter inner core shape and a softer outer edge.
one soft, puffy smoke cloud puff, roughly round with bumpy cauliflower edges, a little brighter in the middle and fading toward its edges.
a scorch mark seen from directly above: an irregular round burnt splat with jagged radiating cracks and a few scattered specks around it, solid in the middle and broken up toward the edges.
one single faceted ice crystal shard, elongated and pointing straight down, its facets shown as slightly different grey levels with a bright white edge highlight.

a square block of clear ice seen from the front, chunky, with bevelled faceted edges: a bright white rim, facet highlight lines and a couple of diagonal glints, and a mostly DARK, nearly black interior so that whatever is behind it shows through.
a ring of jagged ice spikes seen from directly above, radiating outward in a circle like a frost explosion; the centre of the ring is empty black.
a spear made of pure light pointing straight down: a long thin glowing shaft from near the top of the image down to a sharp leaf-shaped blade tip near the bottom, with a soft glow around the blade.
a long thin jagged crack in the ground running vertically from the top edge to the bottom edge of the image, with a few short branching side cracks.
a circular clock rune seen from above: an outer thin ring with 12 evenly spaced tick marks, an inner ring of three curved arrow chevrons all pointing clockwise, and an empty centre.
one small zigzag lightning bolt running horizontally from left to right, a bright core with a faint glow around it.
one stylized feathered wing seen from the side, sweeping up and to the right, with 4 or 5 rounded feathers, flat icon style.
a fissure tearing open in the ground seen from directly above: an elongated jagged crack shape, wide in the middle and narrowing to sharp points at both ends, lying horizontally.
a corrosive acid puddle seen from directly above: an irregular blobby splat with round bubbles of different sizes on it and a few separate droplets around its edge.
a heater-shaped shield icon cracked down the middle into two halves that are breaking apart, with a jagged gap between them and two or three small chips flying off.
four small irregular rust flakes, like chipped paint, each a different shape, laid out in a 2 by 2 grid with plenty of space between them.
